decisions.reason: Adding a drawing dimension between holes does not change the bushing geometry, fit, retention method, or requirement that its existing holes remain unchanged.
The dimensional-annotation change does not alter the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The source's separate file-format clause is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the dimensional-annotation decision requires no additional format-state change.
Retaining one dimension in brackets and adding a functional dimension does not change the existing ČSN/EN compliance or template requirements.
The bracket treatment applies to a specific dimension annotation and does not change the candidate's color-treatment rules for drawing views.
The source changes how dimensions are documented, not the sliding mandrel's geometry, keyway, piston-end arrangement, or retained holes.
Adding a distance dimension between marked holes does not modify the established 45-degree angle between the lug hole axes.
The dimensional-annotation decision has no effect on part materials or the requirement to show materials on drawings.
The source instructs how existing geometry should be dimensioned and does not establish any change to the main shaft's dimensions or features.
The drawing-annotation change does not alter the premachining, welding, or post-weld machining sequence.
The complete drawing-set deliverable remains required unchanged; the new dimension is owned by the technical-annotation Requirement rather than changing the drawing-set Requirement.
The source requires an additional drawing annotation but does not change the geometry or delivery requirement for the 3D shaft assembly model.
